VAL-000005.grounding_summary: The Abarth 500C (Cabriolet) was sold in Israel starting around 2010/2011 until late 2016 when it was replaced by the 595. It features a 1.4L Turbo engine. While the 5-speed robotic automatic was standard, a 5-speed manual was available by special order. The trim '500C' acts as a generic placeholder for the cabriolet body style; specific Israeli trims included Scorpion, Lusso, and later Turismo/Competizione.
